description: Share a local port over the tailnet via Tailscale Serve (tailnet-only by default). WARNING: setting public=true switches to Funnel and exposes the port to the OPEN INTERNET — anyone with the URL can reach it. Only set public=true when internet exposure is explicitly intended. Funnel is DISABLED on this server: public=true returns FUNNEL_DISABLED unless the user sets TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_FUNNEL=1. Returns the resulting URL(s).

path.description: HTTPS mount path on the serve endpoint, e.g. "/api" (default: "/")

public.description: Expose to the open internet via Funnel (default: false = tailnet-only Serve). DANGEROUS: public=true makes the port reachable by anyone on the internet. Disabled unless TAILSCALE_MCP_ALLOW_FUNNEL=1.

name: share_port
title: Share a local port
